# Effort over satisfaction

`customer_support.heu.churn_signal_detection.effort_over_satisfaction` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Effort predicts renewal better than satisfaction does.


## The heuristic

**Effort predicts renewal better than satisfaction does.**


_Why:_ Satisfaction measures how the last interaction felt; effort measures what the product costs to live with. A customer can rate an agent warmly and still be exhausted by how many times they had to ask, and it is the exhaustion that shows up at renewal.
